setup.title: Settings
setup.intro: Set up your organization, its offices, units of measure and document numbering.

validation.officeCode: Use 2–10 capital letters or digits, e.g. MAD.
validation.unitCode: Use up to 20 capital letters, digits, - or _.

organization.title: Organization
organization.intro: Names, logo, contact details and financial settings used on every document.
organization.baseCurrencyHint: Exchange rates are entered against this currency.
organization.baseCurrencyLocked: Fixed because purchase requisitions have already been submitted.
organization.doaReferenceCurrencyHint: Approval amount bands are expressed in this currency.
organization.timezoneHint: Decides the date and year of submissions, e.g. Africa/Khartoum.
organization.maxBackdateDaysHint: How many days before submission a requisition date may be (0–365).
organization.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WEBP or SVG, up to 2 MB. Earlier logos stay on documents already printed.
organization.logoInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WEBP or SVG image of at most 2 MB.

onboarding.title: Create your organization
onboarding.intro: You will be its Organization Admin. Default units, roles, PR numbering and approval steps are added for you and can be changed later.
onboarding.alreadyMember: You already belong to an organization.
onboarding.adminHint: Optional. Your email address is used when left empty.

offices.title: Offices
offices.intro: Offices and locations. The office code is part of every PR number.
offices.dialogIntro: Enter the office's names in both languages and a short code.
offices.codeHint: 2–10 capital letters or digits, e.g. MAD. It appears in PR numbers.
offices.codeLocked: The code cannot change because purchase requisitions already use it in their numbers.
offices.name: Name
offices.empty: No offices yet. Add the first one.

units.title: Units of measure
units.intro: Units used on requisition lines. Deactivate a unit instead of deleting it.

numbering.title: Document numbering
numbering.intro: Format of purchase requisition numbers. Sequences restart every year for each office.
numbering.paddingHint: The sequence is padded with zeros to this many digits (1–10).
numbering.futureOnly: Changes apply only to numbers assigned from now on. Existing numbers never change.

common.noOrganization: You are not a member of any organization yet. Ask your organization's administrator for an invitation.
common.homeIntro: Choose an item from the menu to get started.
common.invalidDate: Enter a valid date as DD/MM/YYYY

auth.magicLinkSent: We sent a sign-in link to your email.
auth.acceptInviteIntro: Choose a password for your account to finish joining.
auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.inviteLinkInvalid: The invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new invitation.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Invite people, assign their roles and offices, and suspend access.
users.inviteIntro: They receive an email with a link to set their password and join the organization.
users.editIntro: Changes apply from now on; past signatures keep the name and position they were signed with.
users.positionTitleHint: Printed on the signatures this user makes.
users.orgWideAccessHint: Without this, the user only sees records of the offices ticked below.
users.name: Name

fieldErrors.already_member: This email already belongs to a member of the organization.
fieldErrors.invalid_reference: One of the selected items no longer exists.
fieldErrors.cannot_suspend_self: You cannot suspend your own account.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. Default roles can be edited too.
roles.editorIntro: Tick the permissions that holders of this role receive.
roles.inUse: This role cannot be deleted while users hold it or an approval rule requires it.
roles.name: Role

approvalRules.title: Approval rules
approvalRules.intro: Who checks and approves purchase requisitions, by office and amount (delegation of authority).
approvalRules.name: Rule name
approvalRules.orgWide: All offices without their own rule
approvalRules.financeLocked: Every requisition goes through the finance check first, whatever the amount.
approvalRules.bandsIntro: Amounts are the requisition total converted to {currency}.

issues.step_order_gap: Step numbers must run 1, 2, 3… without gaps.
issues.first_step_not_finance_check: Step 1 must be the Finance Check.
issues.multiple_finance_check: There can be only one Finance Check step.
issues.finance_check_banded: The Finance Check applies to every amount; it cannot have an amount range.
issues.final_not_highest: Final Approval must be the last step.
issues.non_final_banded: Only Final Approval can have amount ranges.
issues.non_final_multiple_rows: Each step before Final Approval needs exactly one role.
issues.band_not_from_zero: The first amount range must start at 0.
issues.band_gap: The amount ranges leave a gap.
issues.band_not_open_ended: The last amount range must have no upper limit.
issues.band_empty: Each range’s upper limit must be above its lower limit.
issues.role_not_found: Choose a role for every step.
issues.office_not_found: The selected office does not exist.
issues.no_rule: No active approval rule applies to this office.

approvalRules.previewIntro: See which steps a requisition would go through and how many users can sign each one.

grants.title: Grants
grants.name: Grant name
grants.currencyLocked: The currency cannot change because budget lines already have reservations or commitments.
grants.changeStatusIntro: Suspended and closed grants cannot be selected on new requisitions, and pending requisitions cannot be approved.
grants.pendingPrWarning: {count, plural, one {# purchase requisition is} other {# purchase requisitions are}} pending on this grant. They keep their reservations and can still be returned, rejected or cancelled, but no approval step can be signed.
grants.differenceWarning: The budget lines do not add up to the grant total. Difference:

fieldErrors.not_found: The selected item no longer exists.
fieldErrors.before_start_date: The end date must be on or after the start date.

budgetLines.title: Budget lines
budgetLines.belowUsage: The budget cannot be less than what is already reserved, committed and spent:
budgetLines.differenceWarning: Budget lines total differs from the grant total:
budgetLines.empty: No budget lines yet. Add them one by one or import a spreadsheet.

import.title: Import budget lines
import.intro: Upload an Excel (.xlsx) or CSV file. Valid rows become budget lines; invalid rows are listed with the reason and nothing is created from them.
import.columnsHint: Columns: code, description, category, amount. Codes are kept exactly as written (e.g. 2.2.31, 010). Maximum 5 MB.
import.summary: {valid, plural, one {# valid row} other {# valid rows}}, {invalid, plural, one {# invalid row} other {# invalid rows}}.
import.invalidRows: Rows that will not be imported

rowErrors.invalid_category: not one of Supplies, Services, Staff, Equipment, Running costs
rowErrors.invalid_amount: must be greater than zero with at most 2 decimals
rowErrors.duplicate_in_file: the same code appears more than once in the file

import.created: {count, plural, one {# budget line was created.} other {# budget lines were created.}}

fileErrors.missing_columns: The file is missing these columns: {columns}.
fileErrors.too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
fileErrors.unreadable: The file could not be read. Save it again as .xlsx and retry.

rates.title: Exchange rates
rates.intro: Manual rates entered by Finance. A document uses the latest rate on or before its date; on the same date the most recently entered rate applies.
rates.correctionIntro: This rate is used by a purchase requisition and cannot change. The corrected rate is saved as a new entry for the same currency and date and applies from now on.

errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.SEGREGATION_OF_DUTIES: You cannot approve a requisition you created or sign more than one of its steps.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this record. Reload and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different data.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action is not allowed in the requisition's current status.
errors.OFFICE_CODE_IN_USE: The office code cannot change because purchase requisitions use it.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_IN_USE: This rate is used by a purchase requisition. Enter a corrected rate instead of editing it.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: This role is still assigned to users or required by an approval rule.
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: The requested amount exceeds the available balance of the budget line.
errors.BUDGET_BELOW_USAGE: The budget cannot be reduced below what is reserved, committed and spent.
errors.GRANT_NOT_ACTIVE: The grant is not active (suspended or closed).
errors.GRANT_PERIOD_MISMATCH: The requisition date is outside the grant period.
errors.PR_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The requisition date is outside the allowed range.
errors.GRANT_OFFICE_MISMATCH: The requesting office is not one of the grant's offices.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_MISSING: No exchange rate is recorded for one of the currencies on this date.
errors.PR_EMPTY: Add at least one line with a total greater than zero.
errors.REQUIRED_BY_BEFORE_PR_DATE: The required-by date cannot be before the requisition date.
errors.NO_ELIGIBLE_APPROVER: No eligible user exists for one of the approval steps.
errors.APPROVAL_RULE_INVALID: The approval rule is not valid.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_ROWS: There are no valid rows to import.
errors.PR_LINE_GRANT_MISMATCH: The budget line or activity does not belong to the requisition's grant.
errors.EXCHANGE_RATE_BASE_CURRENCY: The base currency does not need an exchange rate.
errors.GRANT_CURRENCY_LOCKED: The grant currency cannot change because its budget lines have reservations or commitments.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server. Check your internet connection.

list.title: Purchase requisitions
list.intro: Create a purchase requisition, or open one from your notifications. The full list with search arrives with the next release.

form.grantNotSelectable: Selected grant (not available for this date or office)
form.grantNeedsDateOffice: Enter the PR date and office first
form.noGrants: No active grant covers this date and office.
form.deleteBody: The draft and its lines are removed permanently. This cannot be undone.
form.conflict: This draft was changed in another window or session. Reload to continue from the latest version.
form.restored: Unsaved changes from your last visit were restored and are being saved.

autosave.error: Could not save — will retry on the next change

errors.required_by_before_pr_date: Must be on or after the PR date

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.limits: Up to {max} files, {size} each: PDF, images, Word, Excel, CSV or text.
attachments.wrongType: {name}: this file type is not allowed.
attachments.tooMany: A requisition can have at most {max} attachments.

submit.incomplete: Complete the highlighted fields before submitting.
submit.budgetExceeded: Some lines exceed the available budget. Reduce them or choose another budget line.
submit.rateMissing: No exchange rate for {currencies} on or before {date}. Contact Finance to record it.
submit.dateOutOfRange: The PR date must be between {earliest} and {latest}.
submit.noApprover: Nobody can sign step {step} ({role}). Ask your administrator to assign the role.

actions.title: Actions
actions.approveIntro: Your name and position are stored with the signature and printed on the PR.
actions.rejectIntro: Rejection is final. The budget held by this PR is released and the requester is notified.
actions.returnIntro: The requester can correct and resubmit the PR with the same number. The budget held is released until then.
actions.resubmitHint: Resubmitting keeps the PR number and restarts the approvals from the finance check with current exchange rates.

changeBudgetLine.title: Change a line's budget line
changeBudgetLine.intro: Move a PR line to another budget line of the same grant. Its reserved amount moves with it.

reassign.title: Reassign a step
reassign.intro: Only the chosen user will be able to sign this step. They are notified.
reassign.noUsers: No other user is eligible for this step.

frozen.title: Grant suspended or closed
frozen.body: This PR cannot be approved while its grant is not active. It can still be returned, rejected or cancelled.
